title: Glitch Text on Black Background
coreRelationships: The glowing orange text strongly contrasts with the dark background.
The distortion effect on the text creates a sense of digital malfunction or retro video artifact.
The advisory label is a small, distinct element that grounds the otherwise abstract text.
The overall composition is centered and balanced, despite the chaotic text effects.
reuseFormula: Generate a dark, noisy background. Overlay large, horizontally glitched, glowing orange-red, bold condensed sans-serif text. Add a small, red, outlined advisory label at the bottom center.
